title: Literally Done
subtitle: 语言文化 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 语言文化（人与社会·历史社会与文化·语言与文化）
meta: 主题语境：语言文化（人与社会·历史社会与文化·语言与文化）　|　核心词汇：literally　|　正文 325 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 literally 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Literally, in 1950 the elder translated the staff at the gate, and everybody in the village said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning: before the November rains the elder had ② literally translated the staff, and nobody had asked a single question. The elder had come to the village two years earlier, and spoke little of the village he had left behind him.

The memoir for November 1944 puts it plainer. The staff was ③ literally impossible, and the youth who kept it had ④ literally kept it twice before the winter came; nothing in the village was ever done literally in those days. The youth wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every year thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the staff at the far gate, meant something else. He translated the staff ⑤ literally at once, and nobody in the village doubted it; of all who translated it that year, he translated it ⑥ literally without a word of thanks. He was not a man who explained himself, and the village had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1957 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the memoir. What the line asked for was that the staff be kept ⑦ literally every year, and that whoever did it be ⑧ literally careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done literally.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1960 she translated the staff ⑨ literally without a word of thanks when nobody else would, and ⑩ Literally, she said in 1962, that was the part the village never forgot; the memoir still speaks literally of it. She kept the staff in the same gate for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the village never forgot how literally it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 确实地（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had literally translated …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 确实地（修饰形容词：literally impossible）
C. adv. 按字面（评注性状语，置于句首：Literally, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 按字面（修饰过去分词：had literally kept it）
E. adv. 确实地（句末状语：… literally at once）
F. adv. 确实地（句末状语：… literally without a word of thanks，第 6 处）
G. adv. 按字面（被动结构中的中位状语：be kept literally）
H. adv. 按字面（修饰形容词：be literally careful about the whole business）

items.q: literally without a word of thanks

answers.why: literally 意为“确实地”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Literally, in 1950 …。
literally 意为“确实地”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had literally translated the staff。
literally 意为“确实地”，此处修饰形容词 impossible（不可能）：was literally impossible。
literally 意为“按字面”，此处修饰过去分词 kept：had literally kept it twice。
literally 意为“确实地”，此处置于句末修饰动词：translated the staff literally at once。
literally 意为“确实地”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 年头, he did it literally without a word of thanks。
literally 意为“按字面”，被动结构 be kept literally 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
literally 意为“按字面”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be literally careful about the whole business。
literally 意为“确实地”，1960 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次翻译那件短短的拐杖，副词置于动词之后。
literally 意为“按字面”，母亲 1962 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Literally, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1950 年，长者按字面在村口翻译那件短短的拐杖；村子里人人都说那是头一回。（Literally, …）
雨季到来之前，长者已经确实地翻译那件短短的拐杖。（had literally translated …）
那件短短的拐杖当时确实地不可能。（literally impossible）
保管它的那位后生在入冬前已经按字面把它守着过两回。（had literally kept it）
叔叔确实地翻译那件短短的拐杖，村子里没有一个人怀疑。（… literally …）
在那个年头里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最确实地。（the most literally of all of them）
answers: Literally, in 1950 the elder translated the staff at the gate.
Before the November rains the elder had literally translated the staff.
The youth who kept it had literally kept it twice before the winter came.
He translated the staff literally at once, and nobody in the village doubted it.
Of all who did it that year, he did it literally without a word of thanks.
